text:
alex: FYI — entitlement-report just flagged ~120 admin grants with NO owner metadata in the last 24h. link: https://internal/reports/entitlements/4202 :eyes:
secbot: automated alert: orphaned-admins-count=118 severity=medium rule=entitlement-ownerless-detect
alex: quick snapshot I pulled:
```
svcacct-data-ingest  -> roles/admin  -> last_used=2026-03-18 02:13 UTC
collector-batch-job -> roles/org-admin -> last_used=2025-11-12 11:01 UTC
analytics-adhoc       -> roles/infra-admin -> last_used=null
kms-key-manager       -> roles/kms-admin -> last_used=2026-01-05 09:23 UTC
```
tara: ugh. some of those are service principals tied to batch jobs. we can't just nuke them.
michael: can we diff against service catalog ownership? run this query on the entitlement DB: 
```sql
SELECT grant_id, principal, role, owner, last_used FROM grants WHERE owner IS NULL AND role LIKE '%admin%' LIMIT 200;
```
alex: ran it. owner is NULL for ~118 rows. ~30 are service-accounts, ~70 are human-ish (old emails), ~18 are KMS grants bound to older projects.
jean: proposal: (1) create a "quarantine" tag on the grants so they can be tracked, (2) insert temporary restriction policy (no new token minting) for svc accounts with last_used > 90d, (3) launch owner-claim flow for humans. minimal blast radius.
alex: agree. what about scheduled jobs that will fail if we restrict? need allowlist for infra-critical jobs.
tara: we have runbook fragment: add allowlist via tag "allowlist-keep" on the grant object. runbook step: notify owning-team 72h before enforced change. If no response, rotate creds and create service-account with least-priv roles.
michael: for KMS keys, we must be careful — can't auto-rotate or remove kms-admins without key policy updates. jean, can you open an ops-approval PR for KMS key policy changes? include the required rollback steps.
jean: will do. PR checklist will include: impact matrix, runbook link, smoke tests, contact list. I'll also add a CloudTrail/Audit hook to stream grant-change events to security-logs-index.
alex: +1. Logging change — add a log tag so we can trace remediation actions. Command I used to tag items (internal tool):
```bash
entctl tag grant --id 0x4f2a --tag quarantine:2026-03-23 --reason "ownerless entitle triage"
```
secbot: incident created: INC-2026-2247 (entitlement-orphan-surge). Slack channel #inc-INC-2026-2247 created.
tara: volunteer to run first canary? need someone to monitor job runs and rollback if failures.
jean: I can run the canary for non-KMS svc accounts. plan: pick 10 low-risk svc accounts, tag, insert restriction for 48h, monitor metrics (error-rate, job-latency).
michael: I'll own KMS part — will coordinate with platform and run policy change in staging first. will post the PR link here when ready.
alex: timeline: canary start tomorrow 09:00 PT, 48h window, if no critical alerts -> scale to 200 grants over 7 days with comms.
jean: doc: https://internal/docs/sec/ownerless-entitlement-playbook v1.0 added.
oncall-bot: reminder set: INCIDENT followup in 72h for status update.
alex: next actions: jean opens ops PR + canary list, michael posts kms-PR, tara prepares comms template, i'll update incident ticket with kron job allowlist. tagging folks: @jean @michael @tara :thumbsup:
jean: on it. :rocket:
